the war underlines that

China

What does this tell us about China's

it seems to me the United States isn't

that is one of the countries that really

willing to do that much to really

wherever this war ends up, there are a

beneficiaries is that in their minds,

our way of fighting. It seems to me that

that's why I think, you know, there's a
there's a story that the Chinese were

the challenges of guerrilla warfare, and

in more akin to what the US is trying to
um in terms of trying to use force to

standing? I think the the biggest issue

the the status quo power, the guarantor

American president and an administration

in a goal of getting more.

don't question their own legitimacy.

their minds governments are legitimate.

how much can you work together? I think
in their minds are they pro-China? Are
they anti-China?
Uh, you know, are they Is there a room
to try and move them in a direction

positive for China? Does this war affect

that was
reinforced at the end of the Cold War.

seizing territory. I think when the
Chinese look at what has happened, they

I think there's a conventional argument

This gives us legitimacy, etc., etc."
with regard to Taiwan. The reality is
the Chinese believe
that they already have legitimacy with

benefited tremendously from the status
quo, and you can argue that in the last
30 years no 35 years no country has

A change in the global order that is not
